meta_description: SAF Painting & Decorating in Newcastle offers interior and exterior painting, decorating, and refurbishment. Professional finishes, competitive rates. Call today.
hero_subhead: From fresh interior walls to complete exterior transformations, we deliver a flawless finish on time and on budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether it's a single room refresh or a full property renovation, we handle interior and exterior work with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature finishes. We prep thoroughly, use quality paints, and deliver sharp edges and lasting colour that transforms your living space.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Protect and refresh fascias, soffits, doors, and render. Weather-resistant finishes that stand up to Newcastle's climate and enhance your home's kerb appeal.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Professional hanging on any surface — lining, paste application, and pattern matching done right. Feature walls that make a real impact.

services.title: Damp-Proofing & Preparation
services.desc: We treat damp issues, repair plasterwork, and prepare all surfaces properly before decoration — no shortcuts, professional results.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Office, retail, and industrial spaces. We work around your schedule, manage disruption, and deliver a professional finish that reflects your brand.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Polished plaster, lime wash, Venetian techniques, and bespoke colour matching. Bring character and luxury finishes to any room.

about_pullquote: We treat every home as if it were our own — attention to detail, no mess left behind.
about_para_1: SAF Painting & Decorating has been transforming homes and businesses across Newcastle for over a decade. Based in Jesmond, we've built our reputation on meticulous preparation, quality materials, and finishes that last. Every project is overseen personally to ensure your satisfaction.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen to what you want, deliver on time, and leave your space spotless. We're fully insured, use premium paints and materials, and take pride in the detail others miss. From a single accent wall to a complete refurbishment, you can trust us to get it right.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the whole lounge and hallway redecorated. The lads were professional, tidy, and finished bang on schedule. Really happy with the finish — the colour is exactly what we wanted. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Exterior cladding and fascia work. Weather was awful but they got it done without cutting corners. Quality job, no mess, and they even tidied up the garden. Fair price and honest about timescale from the start.
reviews.author: Angela S.

reviews.text: Stripped wallpaper, repaired walls, and hung new paper in the bedroom. Attention to detail was brilliant — seams are invisible and corners are sharp. Would recommend without hesitation.
reviews.author: David H.
